add_library(libs-model-cuda)

if (HAVE_ROCM)
  if(${CMAKE_VERSION} VERSION_LESS "3.17.0")
      message(FATAL_ERROR "Build with HIP requires at least cmake 3.17.0")
  endif()

  enable_language(HIP)
  set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "${CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS} -D__HIP_PLATFORM_AMD__")


  find_package(HIP REQUIRED)
  target_include_directories(libs-model-cuda PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
endif()

target_link_libraries(libs-model-cuda PUBLIC
  contrib-libs-linux-headers
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  catboost-libs-model
  cpp-cuda-wrappers
  internal-platform-cuda
)

target_cuda_sources(libs-model-cuda PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/catboost/libs/model/cuda/evaluator.cu
)

if (NOT HAVE_ROCM)
target_cuda_flags(libs-model-cuda
  -lineinfo
  --use_fast_math
  -Wno-deprecated-gpu-targets
)
endif()

add_global_library_for(libs-model-cuda.global
  libs-model-cuda)

if(HAVE_ROCM)
    target_include_directories(libs-model-cuda.global PRIVATE ${HIP_INCLUDE_DIRS})
    # Only add link directories if catboost CLI target exists (not building python-package only)
    if(TARGET catboost)
        target_link_directories(catboost PRIVATE /opt/rocm/lib)
    endif()
endif()

target_link_libraries(libs-model-cuda.global PUBLIC
  contrib-libs-linux-headers
  contrib-libs-cxxsupp
  yutil
  catboost-libs-model
  cpp-cuda-wrappers
  internal-platform-cuda
)

target_sources(libs-model-cuda.global PRIVATE
  ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/catboost/libs/model/cuda/evaluator.cpp
)
